Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

comparison — the act of comparing things. Example: My comparison is simple.
opinion — what you think about something. Example: In my opinion the village is better.
preference — the thing you like more. Example: My preference is the village.
better — of higher quality than another. Example: I like the red one better.
worse — of lower quality than another. Example: The traffic is worse in the city.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• The ... is ... than the ...
• In my opinion ...
• It is better for ...
• It is worse for ...
• Thank you for listening.

Grammar focus: Comparative adjectives (-er than, more ... than).
Present a comparison in three parts: the two things, the differences, your opinion. Use -er than and I think: The city is busier than the village. I think the village is better for families.

elements.content: Reading: read the text and answer the questions.
My comparison: the city is bigger and busier than my village, but the village is quieter and cheaper. In my opinion the village is better for families, but the city is better for work.
Listening: listen to the dialogue and answer the questions.
A: Compare the city and the village. B: The city is busier, but the village is quieter. A: Which do you prefer? B: The village.
